nodes.label: Signup Page Illustration — undraw 'remotely' scene featuring a flat-style vector illustration (artist: Katerina Limpitsouni, undraw.co). The composition includes: a central human figure (person with dark hair) seated at a laptop/desktop computer setup, wearing a purple/indigo outfit, representing a remote worker or user signing up. Background elements include decorative plant motifs (stylised leafy branches in purple/indigo #6c63ff and grey), multiple floating UI card/list components with checklist rows (dark #3f3d56 panels), a large bookshelf or storage rack unit on the right side, and abstract horizontal lines evoking a workspace or office environment. Colour palette: indigo/violet (#6c63ff), near-black (#3f3d56, #2f2e41), light grey (#e6e6e6, #ccc), white, and skin-tone peach (#ffb8b8). Style is the characteristic undraw flat illustration style with no outlines, bold fills, and simplified geometric shapes. Overall mood conveys digital onboarding, account creation, or remote productivity.
nodes.author: Katerina Limpitsouni
